name: UCREST
recent: UCrest 正在推进私募配售，已获 Bursa Securities 批准将完成期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 4 月 23 日。公司于 2025 年 11 月 12 日召开第 28 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会，所有决议均获通过，包括设立员工认股计划（ESOS）。最新财报显示季度营收环比下降 7.1%，净亏损为 48.2 万令吉。
notable: Bursa Securities approved a 6-month extension, from 24 October 2026 to 23 April 2027, for the company to complete its private placement.。
All resolutions were passed at the 28th AGM held on 12 November 2025, including directors' fees and re-election of directors.。
All resolutions were passed at the EGM held on 12 November 2025, including the establishment of an ESOS of up to 30% of issued shares.。
risks: The private placement remains uncompleted and its implementation period has been extended to 23 April 2027.。
The company reported a net loss of RM482,000 for the quarter ended 31 August 2026.。
The proposed ESOS may dilute existing shareholders' holdings if options are exercised.。
earnings: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM3.963 million, down 7.1% QoQ but up 19.7% YoY. Net loss was RM482,000, with net margin at -12.2% versus -14.5% in the prior quarter.。

recent_en: UCrest is proceeding with a private placement, having obtained Bursa Securities' approval for a 6-month extension to complete it by 23 April 2027. The company held its 28th AGM and EGM on 12 November 2025, where all resolutions were passed, including the establishment of an ESOS. The latest quarterly results show revenue down 7.1% QoQ and a net loss of RM482,000.
notable_en: Bursa Securities approved a 6-month extension, from 24 October 2026 to 23 April 2027, for the company to complete its private placement.
All resolutions were passed at the 28th AGM held on 12 November 2025, including directors' fees and re-election of directors.
All resolutions were passed at the EGM held on 12 November 2025, including the establishment of an ESOS of up to 30% of issued shares.
risks_en: The private placement remains uncompleted and its implementation period has been extended to 23 April 2027.
The company reported a net loss of RM482,000 for the quarter ended 31 August 2026.
The proposed ESOS may dilute existing shareholders' holdings if options are exercised.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM3.963 million, down 7.1% QoQ but up 19.7% YoY. Net loss was RM482,000, with net margin at -12.2% versus -14.5% in the prior quarter.
